checks: Checked 04efecf44a49379d §§3–4, (6)–(13), including the rational specialization and n=0.

The lattice projection is precisely the cube and each integer base is extreme. Different sites have a strict isolation gap, and strict exclusive witnesses exist in the relative interior near each corresponding simplex vertex. Compactness preserves these gaps under the stated small paths.

The affine map X↦X+tλ_j(X)h has determinant 1+tr_j, with some r_i>0 since the barycentric map is injective and the r_i sum to zero. In the changed cap trace only vertex i stays above the threshold; its edge products give the stated diagonal and off-diagonal derivatives.

The normalized derivative in the moved fiber is D_ij r_i/N+q(N−1)r_j/N², and every other fiber has −qr_j/N². If r_j<0 and N>1 an unchanged fiber pays a positive derivative; otherwise a positive r_i supplies it on the moved fiber. The finite initially tied maximum has the largest right derivative.

The common scale changes each pulled-back threshold by positive derivative 1/(d+1)−c while cancelling all common volume factors. At n=1,d=2,c=1/4 this gives 9/32, D coefficients 3/8 and 9/16, and −1/16. The rational verifier passed.
